map.演讲计时器，为 PPT 每页分配时间并进度提醒、支持全屏，辅助演讲节奏把控。: The presentation timer allocates time per PPT slide with progress reminders and full-screen support, helping you keep the pace of a talk.
map.单页秒数 = ⌊总时长 × 60 / 页数⌋；手动调整后需校验 Σ单页秒数 与: Seconds per slide = floor(total duration x 60 / slide count); after manual adjustment, check the deviation between the sum of per-slide seconds and total duration x 60
map.均分用向下取整，因此 Σ单页秒数 ≤ 总时长，余数（最多 页数−1 秒）被舍去，: Equal division uses floor, so the sum of per-slide seconds is at most the total; the remainder (at most slides - 1 seconds) is dropped. This is negligible for long talks but noticeably tight for a short meeting (such as 1 minute over 10 slides), so add the remainder back manually. In rehearsal, Q&A and scene changes are often left out; a practical approach is to reserve a 15% to 20% buffer before equal division. The timer increments with browser time, and some browsers throttle timers on background tabs, so cross-check with a system clock or an external stopwatch for critical occasions.
map.演讲与路演控时：设定总时长与分段提醒，避免超时或被叫停。: Control timing for speeches and pitches: set the total duration and section reminders to avoid running over or being cut off.
map.教学与培训分段：为每节预设时间，到点提示切换内容。: Teaching and training segmented timing: preset a time per section and get a reminder to switch content.
map.排练（dry run）：按真实节奏计时，评估内容密度是否合适。: Rehearsal (dry run): time it at the real pace to judge whether the content density is right.
map.：设总时长 15:00、在第 5/10 分钟提醒，演示时屏幕倒计时；若第 10: Set the total at 15:00 with reminders at minutes 5 and 10, and show a countdown during the talk; if the core content is not done by minute 10, plan to cut so there is 3 minutes for questions.
